title: EP027 世界杯：130亿美元，FIFA的金钱与权力游戏
title_en: EP027 The World Cup: $13 Billion — FIFA's Game of Money and Power
summary_cn: Ready Go 主播 Marc 拆解 2026 美加墨世界杯背后的百亿生意：FIFA 四年周期预计收入 130 亿美元，转播权（40%）、赞助（25%）、门票（28%）三大引擎驱动；价格歧视、动态定价、二手转售抽成与 TikTok 创作者合作标志商业化进入激进新阶段；而总部瑞士的非营利组织，手握全球足球的行政、立法、司法三权
summary_en: Ready Go host Marc breaks down the billion-dollar business behind the 2026 World Cup in the United States, Canada, and Mexico. FIFA expects about $13 billion in revenue over the four-year cycle, driven by three engines: broadcast rights at 40 percent, sponsorship at 25 percent, and tickets at 28 percent. Price discrimination, dynamic pricing, resale commissions, and a TikTok creator partnership mark a new, aggressive phase of commercialization. Meanwhile, the nonprofit based in Switzerland holds the executive, legislative, and judicial powers of global football all in one hand.

scenes.title_cn: 一、2026 世界杯：史上最大规模
scenes.title_en: The 2026 World Cup: The Biggest One Ever
scenes.context: 48 队 104 场扩军背后的「总量赢」逻辑；FIFA 的算盘与成本外部化。语域：formal 商业分析 + 播客点评。
scenes.speak: Let's start with scale. The mechanism: from 32 teams and 64 matches in 1998 to 48 teams and 104 matches — a 63 percent increase — with three host countries this time. More matches equals more broadcast content, more sponsor exposure, and more tickets to sell. The key insight: FIFA's bet is on total volume. Even if the value per match drops from dilution, the total revenue from 104 matches could still beat 64. It contrasts with the underwhelming joint hosting by South Korea and Japan in 2002 — but the money smell behind 2026 is much stronger. A typical scene: when evaluating any scale-up business decision, separate the two dimensions — total growth versus per-unit value dilution. The original line: "Even if the revenue per match drops, if the total from 104 matches still beats 64, then I'm in." And here's the irony: the players are trained by clubs, the stadiums are built by host countries, and the hosts even shoulder heavy infrastructure costs — yet the most profitable part belongs to FIFA, based in Zurich, Switzerland. It's not even a corporation; it's a nonprofit organization. In FIFA's own terms: "The players at the World Cup aren't trained by FIFA, and the venues aren't built with FIFA's money — yet the most profitable part of the World Cup's revenue belongs to FIFA."

sentences.cn: 核心机制：从 1998 年的 32 队 64 场扩至 48 队 104 场（+63%），同时美加墨三国联办。更多比赛 = 更多转播内容 + 更多赞助露出 + 更多门票可售
sentences.en: The mechanism: from 32 teams and 64 matches in 1998 to 48 teams and 104 matches — a 63 percent increase — with three host countries this time. More matches equals more broadcast content, more sponsor exposure, and more tickets to sell.
sentences.note: 表达提示broadcast content → 转播内容；sponsor exposure → 赞助露出；host country → 主办国

sentences.cn: 关键理解：FIFA 的算盘是「总量赢」——即便单场价值因稀释而下降，104 场总收入仍可能超过 64 场。这与 2002 韩日联办效果不佳形成对比，但 2026 背后「金钱气息」更浓
sentences.en: The key insight: FIFA's bet is on total volume. Even if the value per match drops from dilution, the total revenue from 104 matches could still beat 64. It contrasts with the underwhelming joint hosting by South Korea and Japan in 2002 — but the money smell behind 2026 is much stronger.
sentences.note: 表达提示value per match → 单场价值；dilution → 稀释；joint hosting → 联办

sentences.cn: 典型场景：评估任何「规模扩张」商业决策时，区分「总量增长」与「单位价值稀释」两个维度
sentences.en: A typical scene: when evaluating any scale-up business decision, separate the two dimensions — total growth versus per-unit value dilution.
sentences.note: 表达提示scale-up → 规模扩张；per-unit value → 单位价值

sentences.cn: （引用）原文依据：「即便单场收入下降，那么 104 场的总收入如果还是超过 64 场，那我就搞。」
sentences.en: "Even if the revenue per match drops, if the total from 104 matches still beats 64, then I'm in."
sentences.note: 表达提示total revenue → 总收入；beats → 超过

sentences.cn: 参赛球员由俱乐部培养、比赛场地由主办国修建、甚至主办国要承担大量基建成本——但最赚钱的部分却属于总部瑞士苏黎世的 FIFA。它甚至不是企业，而是非营利组织
sentences.en: The players are trained by clubs, the stadiums are built by host countries, and the hosts even shoulder heavy infrastructure costs — yet the most profitable part belongs to FIFA, based in Zurich, Switzerland. It's not even a corporation; it's a nonprofit organization.
sentences.note: 表达提示shoulder the costs → 承担成本；infrastructure → 基建；nonprofit organization → 非营利组织

sentences.cn: （引用）「世界杯的参赛球员不是 FIFA 培养的，比赛场地也不是 FIFA 花钱建设的，但世界杯最赚钱的那部分收入，却属于 FIFA。」
sentences.en: "The players at the World Cup aren't trained by FIFA, and the venues aren't built with FIFA's money — yet the most profitable part of the World Cup's revenue belongs to FIFA."
sentences.note: 表达提示venue → 比赛场地；profitable → 赚钱的

paraphrase.intent: 想说「规模变大但单场价值变低」
phrases: More games, but each one is worth less.
Volume is up even though unit value is diluted.
paraphrase.usage: 第一句口语总结，第二句商务表达

paraphrase.intent: 想说「成本别人出，钱自己赚」
phrases: They build it; FIFA pockets the profit.
Someone else foots the bill, FIFA banks the money.
paraphrase.chunks: pockets the profit · foots the bill
paraphrase.usage: 第一句简洁，第二句更口语

scenes.title_cn: 二、转播权：FIFA 的现金牛（40%，约 50 亿美元）
scenes.title_en: Broadcast Rights: FIFA's Cash Cow (40%, About $5 Billion)
scenes.context: 信号制作、套餐拆分与「价格歧视」定价逻辑；中国市场为何低价。语域：formal 商业机制讲解。
scenes.speak: Next, the cash cow. The mechanism: FIFA produces the unified broadcast feed itself — slow motion, aerial shots, data graphics — then splits it into packages by platform, by match range, and by language, negotiating prices country by country, broadcaster by broadcaster. The key insight: this is classic price discrimination — the same product sold at different prices based on each market's willingness to pay, like an airline charging different fares on the same flight. A typical scene: IP licensing, SaaS pricing, and content distribution can all borrow the strategy of splitting rights and differentiating prices. The related concept: unlike sponsors' exclusivity, broadcast rights sell the right to air the games, and the buyer makes money through ads and subscriptions. The numbers tell the story: "One language version in the US alone brings in nearly 500 million, while the entire Indian market pays only 60 million — an eightfold gap." And the reason in China: China Media Group is the sole buyer and FIFA can't go around it; the time difference puts games in the early morning and hurts ratings; and with no Chinese team in the tournament, FIFA's bargaining power weakens further.

sentences.cn: 核心机制：FIFA 统一拍摄制作信号（慢动作、航拍、数据画面），按平台（电视/流媒体）、赛事范围（104 场/64 场/淘汰赛）、语言（英语/西班牙语）拆分成不同套餐，逐国逐台谈判定价
sentences.en: The mechanism: FIFA produces the unified broadcast feed itself — slow motion, aerial shots, data graphics — then splits it into packages by platform, by match range, and by language, negotiating prices country by country, broadcaster by broadcaster.
sentences.note: 表达提示broadcast feed → 转播信号；package → 套餐；broadcaster → 电视台

sentences.cn: 关键理解：这是典型的「价格歧视」——同一产品根据市场支付意愿卖不同价格，类似航空公司同一航班不同时间不同票价
sentences.en: The key insight: this is classic price discrimination — the same product sold at different prices based on each market's willingness to pay, like an airline charging different fares on the same flight.
sentences.note: 表达提示price discrimination → 价格歧视；willingness to pay → 支付意愿；fare → 票价

sentences.cn: 典型场景：IP 授权、SaaS 定价、内容分发都可借鉴「权益拆分 + 差异化定价」策略
sentences.en: A typical scene: IP licensing, SaaS pricing, and content distribution can all borrow the strategy of splitting rights and differentiating prices.
sentences.note: 表达提示IP licensing → IP 授权；differentiated pricing → 差异化定价

sentences.cn: （引用）相关概念：与赞助商的「排他权」不同，转播权卖的是「播放权」，买方靠广告和订阅变现
sentences.en: Related concept: unlike sponsors' exclusivity, broadcast rights sell the right to air the games, and the buyer makes money through ads and subscriptions.
sentences.note: 表达提示exclusivity → 排他权；air the games → 播放比赛；subscription → 订阅

sentences.cn: （引用）原文依据：「美国一个语言版本就要将近收 5 亿，印度全国市场才 6000 万美元，8 倍的价差。」
sentences.en: "One language version in the US alone brings in nearly 500 million, while the entire Indian market pays only 60 million — an eightfold gap."
sentences.note: 表达提示eightfold gap → 8 倍价差；bring in → 带来收入

sentences.cn: 原因：央广总台是独家买家，FIFA 无法绕过；时差导致凌晨比赛降低收视率；无中国队参赛进一步削弱议价
sentences.en: The reason: China Media Group is the sole buyer and FIFA can't go around it; the time difference puts games in the early morning and hurts ratings; and with no Chinese team in the tournament, FIFA's bargaining power weakens further.
sentences.note: 表达提示sole buyer → 独家买家；time difference → 时差；bargaining power → 议价能力

paraphrase.intent: 想说「同一个产品卖不同价」
phrases: Same product, wildly different prices.
They charge whatever each market will bear.
paraphrase.chunks: same product · different prices · will bear
paraphrase.usage: 第一句口语，第二句商务化

phrases: With only one buyer, the price stays low.
Being the sole buyer gives you all the leverage.
paraphrase.usage: 第一句描述结果，第二句讲原理

scenes.title_cn: 三、赞助商：三层金字塔（25%，约 32 亿美元）
scenes.title_en: Sponsors: The Three-Tier Pyramid (25%, About $3.2 Billion)
scenes.context: 排他权如何绑定品牌；海信、蒙牛、伊利三种赞助姿势对比。语域：formal 商业案例 + 播客点评。
scenes.speak: Then the sponsors. The key insight: sponsors are buying more than ad exposure — they're buying FIFA's official endorsement plus category exclusivity. With Coca-Cola in, Pepsi can never become a partner. How to apply it: when evaluating sports or big-IP sponsorship, ask how much the exclusivity is worth — not just the CPM exposure. Three Chinese companies show three postures. Hisense, Lenovo, and Vivo are going-global companies using the World Cup's global exposure to expand overseas. Hisense's overseas share rose from 20 percent before its 2018 sponsorship to 50 percent by 2025. Mengniu's overseas business is tiny; its goal is to influence Chinese viewers and lift brand trust in a duopoly battle with Yili — at a cost in the 65 to 95 million dollar range. And Yili skipped the official sponsorship and spent about 20 million yuan on a Xiaohongshu tie-in to ride the traffic — the contrast is stark. In total, for the 2026 cycle, Chinese sponsors — Mengniu, Lenovo, and Hisense — put in 320 million dollars combined, about 10 percent of FIFA's sponsorship revenue for that cycle.

sentences.cn: 关键理解：赞助商买的不仅是广告曝光，更是「FIFA 官方背书」+「行业排他权」——可口可乐在，百事永远不可能成为合作伙伴
sentences.en: The key insight: sponsors are buying more than ad exposure — they're buying FIFA's official endorsement plus category exclusivity. With Coca-Cola in, Pepsi can never become a partner.
sentences.note: 表达提示official endorsement → 官方背书；category exclusivity → 行业排他权

sentences.cn: （引用）怎么落地：评估体育/大型 IP 赞助时，核心问「排他权值多少钱」而非仅看 CPM 曝光
sentences.en: How to apply it: when evaluating sports or big-IP sponsorship, ask how much the exclusivity is worth — not just the CPM exposure.
sentences.note: 表达提示CPM → 千次曝光成本；exclusivity is worth → 排他权的价值

sentences.cn: 海信 / 联想 / Vivo：出海型企业，借世界杯全球曝光拓展海外业务。海信海外占比从 2018 年赞助前的 20% 升至 2025 年的 50%
sentences.en: Hisense, Lenovo, and Vivo are going-global companies using the World Cup's global exposure to expand overseas. Hisense's overseas share rose from 20 percent before its 2018 sponsorship to 50 percent by 2025.
sentences.note: 表达提示going-global → 出海；overseas share → 海外占比

sentences.cn: 蒙牛：海外业务极小，赞助目的是影响中国观众、在与伊利的双寡头竞争中提升品牌信任度（花费 6500-9500 万美元级别）
sentences.en: Mengniu's overseas business is tiny; its goal is to influence Chinese viewers and lift brand trust in a duopoly battle with Yili — at a cost in the 65 to 95 million dollar range.
sentences.note: 表达提示duopoly → 双寡头；brand trust → 品牌信任度

sentences.cn: 伊利：未买官方赞助，花约 2000 万人民币与小红书合作蹭流量——高下立见
sentences.en: Yili skipped the official sponsorship and spent about 20 million yuan on a Xiaohongshu tie-in to ride the traffic — the contrast is stark.
sentences.note: 表达提示tie-in → 联动合作；ride the traffic → 蹭流量；stark contrast → 高下立见

sentences.cn: （引用）2026 届中国赞助商（蒙牛+联想+海信）合计投入 3.2 亿美元，占 FIFA 该周期赞助费 10%
sentences.en: For the 2026 cycle, Chinese sponsors — Mengniu, Lenovo, and Hisense — put in 320 million dollars combined, about 10 percent of FIFA's sponsorship revenue for that cycle.
sentences.note: 表达提示combined → 合计；sponsorship revenue → 赞助费收入

paraphrase.intent: 想说「买的是排他权不是曝光」
phrases: They're paying to block the competitor, not just to be seen.
Exclusivity is the real purchase here.
paraphrase.chunks: block the competitor · the real purchase
paraphrase.usage: 第一句通俗，第二句是观点

phrases: They skipped the official deal and rode the hype.
Free-riding on the buzz instead of paying the fee.
paraphrase.chunks: rode the hype · free-riding on the buzz
paraphrase.usage: 第一句中性，第二句带贬义色彩

scenes.title_cn: 四、门票：动态定价与转售抽成（28%，约 36 亿美元）
scenes.title_en: Tickets: Dynamic Pricing and Resale Commissions (28%, About $3.6 Billion)
scenes.context: 动态定价首年启用；官方转售抽成几乎零成本；门票商业化争议。语域：formal 机制讲解 + 争议讨论。
scenes.speak: Now tickets. The reason: 2026 is the first year of dynamic pricing, which adjusts prices in real time based on popularity, demand, city, and stage. US team group-stage tickets already top 1,000 dollars each, and finals start at 4,000. The solution, for FIFA: hospitality VIP packages — from 2,000 to hundreds of thousands per match — are the real profit driver. Regular tickets and VIP bring in roughly even revenue, but the profit margins are worlds apart. Severity: commercially rational, but it drifts from the charter's purpose of "promoting the development of football," sparking complaints about over-commercialization. As one comment puts it: "More expensive tickets may lock out true football fans who can't afford them — watching on TV and feeling the stadium atmosphere are completely different things." The mechanism: resale used to be capped at face value — buy at 60, sell at 60. In 2026, sellers can set their own price, and both sides pay a 15 percent service fee. On a 1,000 dollar resale, FIFA takes 300, almost entirely free money. The key insight: dynamic pricing plus resale commissions push this tournament's ticket revenue to four times the previous edition — a vivid sign of FIFA's increasingly aggressive commercialization.

sentences.cn: 原因：2026 年首次采用动态定价，综合热门程度、抢票人数、城市、阶段等因素实时调价。美国队小组赛已破 1000 美元/张，决赛最低 4000 美元起
sentences.en: The reason: 2026 is the first year of dynamic pricing, which adjusts prices in real time based on popularity, demand, city, and stage. US team group-stage tickets already top $1,000 each, and finals start at $4,000.
sentences.note: 表达提示dynamic pricing → 动态定价；group-stage → 小组赛；finals → 决赛

sentences.cn: 解法：对 FIFA 而言，Hospitality VIP 套餐（单场 2000-数十万美元）才是利润主力，普通门票与 VIP 收入 55 开但利润悬殊
sentences.en: The solution, for FIFA: hospitality VIP packages — from $2,000 to hundreds of thousands per match — are the real profit driver. Regular tickets and VIP bring in roughly even revenue, but the profit margins are worlds apart.
sentences.note: 表达提示hospitality package → 高端观赛套餐；profit driver → 利润主力；profit margin → 利润率

sentences.cn: 严重程度：商业上合理，但偏离「促进足球运动发展」章程宗旨，引发过度商业化争议
sentences.en: Severity: commercially rational, but it drifts from the charter's purpose of "promoting the development of football," sparking complaints about over-commercialization.
sentences.note: 表达提示charter → 章程；over-commercialization → 过度商业化

sentences.cn: （引用）越来越贵的门票可能把真正热爱足球但收入不高的球迷挡在球场外——电视看和现场感受完全是两回事
sentences.en: "More expensive tickets may lock out true football fans who can't afford them — watching on TV and feeling the stadium atmosphere are completely different things."
sentences.note: 表达提示lock out → 挡在门外；stadium atmosphere → 现场氛围

sentences.cn: 核心机制：以往官方转售只能按原价（60 美元买入只能 60 美元卖出）。2026 年允许自定转售价，买卖双方各收 15% 服务费。1000 美元成交，FIFA 抽 300 美元，几乎零成本
sentences.en: The mechanism: resale used to be capped at face value — buy at $60, sell at $60. In 2026, sellers can set their own price, and both sides pay a 15 percent service fee. On a $1,000 resale, FIFA takes $300, almost entirely free money.
sentences.note: 表达提示face value → 原价/面值；service fee → 服务费；free money → 零成本进账

sentences.cn: 关键理解：动态定价 + 转售抽成使本届门票收入达上届 4 倍。这是 FIFA 商业化「越来越激进」的直观体现
sentences.en: The key insight: dynamic pricing plus resale commissions push this tournament's ticket revenue to four times the previous edition — a vivid sign of FIFA's increasingly aggressive commercialization.
sentences.note: 表达提示previous edition → 上一届；aggressive commercialization → 激进的商业化

phrases: FIFA takes a cut from both sides.
Both the buyer and seller pay the 15 percent.
paraphrase.usage: 第一句简洁，第二句具体

paraphrase.intent: 想说「VIP 才是利润大头」
phrases: The real money is in the VIP packages.
Regular tickets barely move the profit needle.
paraphrase.chunks: the real money · VIP packages · profit needle
paraphrase.usage: 第一句点题，第二句对比

scenes.title_cn: 五、新尝试：TikTok 创作者合作
scenes.title_en: A New Experiment: Partnering with TikTok Creators
scenes.context: 不卖完整转播权，让创作者二创传播，试水长尾变现。语域：formal 策略分析。
scenes.speak: Then a new experiment. The mechanism: FIFA partners with TikTok without selling full broadcast rights — highlights, interviews, and behind-the-scenes clips can be re-created and spread. Thirty global creators are chosen for behind-the-scenes interview access, with content published only on TikTok and no revenue cut for FIFA. The key insight: it's a proof of concept. Top-tier sponsorships cost tens of millions, which small and mid-size brands can't afford; but creators can reach the long tail of brands through single-video deals, potentially widening FIFA's revenue frontier. A typical scene: big IPs extending from a few headline sponsors to a long-tail monetization path through the creator economy. And another hypothesis: more influencers would pay top dollar to attend — even just to film vlogs rather than match footage — pushing up ticket demand in sync with dynamic pricing.

sentences.cn: 核心机制：FIFA 与 TikTok 合作，非完整转播权，但允许精彩片段、采访、花絮二创传播。选拔 30 位全球创作者获得幕后采访权，内容仅限 TikTok 发布，FIFA 不抽成
sentences.en: The mechanism: FIFA partners with TikTok without selling full broadcast rights — highlights, interviews, and behind-the-scenes clips can be re-created and spread. Thirty global creators are chosen for behind-the-scenes interview access, with content published only on TikTok and no revenue cut for FIFA.
sentences.note: 表达提示highlights → 精彩片段；behind-the-scenes → 幕后花絮；revenue cut → 抽成

sentences.cn: 关键理解：这是模式验证——顶级赞助动辄数千万美元，中小品牌出不起；但创作者可接触长尾品牌（单条视频赞助费），未来可能拓宽 FIFA 收入边界
sentences.en: The key insight: it's a proof of concept. Top-tier sponsorships cost tens of millions, which small and mid-size brands can't afford; but creators can reach the long tail of brands through single-video deals, potentially widening FIFA's revenue frontier.
sentences.note: 表达提示proof of concept → 模式验证；long tail → 长尾；revenue frontier → 收入边界

sentences.cn: 典型场景：大型 IP 从「头部金主」向「创作者经济」延伸的长尾变现路径
sentences.en: A typical scene: big IPs extending from a few headline sponsors to a long-tail monetization path through the creator economy.
sentences.note: 表达提示headline sponsor → 头部金主；creator economy → 创作者经济

sentences.cn: （引用）另一假说：更多 KOL 愿花重金到现场（即使只拍 VLOG 不拍比赛画面），推高门票需求，与动态定价形成共振
sentences.en: Another hypothesis: more influencers would pay top dollar to attend — even just to film vlogs rather than match footage — pushing up ticket demand in sync with dynamic pricing.
sentences.note: 表达提示influencer → 网红/KOL；in sync with → 与…共振；top dollar → 高价

paraphrase.intent: 想说「大品牌出不起，让创作者来」
phrases: Sponsorships are too pricey — so try creators.
Open the door to the long tail.
paraphrase.usage: 第一句通俗，第二句是策略词

phrases: It's a pilot for a bigger play.
Test the model first, scale later.
paraphrase.chunks: a pilot · test the model · scale later
paraphrase.usage: 第一句口语，第二句商务化

scenes.title_cn: 六、130 亿去哪了：非营利组织的资金循环
scenes.title_en: Where the $13 Billion Goes: A Nonprofit's Money Cycle
scenes.context: 非营利不等于不赚钱；协议+分期+验收的拨款机制。语域：formal 机制讲解。
scenes.speak: So where does the 13 billion go? The key insight: nonprofit does not mean not profitable. What's restricted is profit distribution — no shareholder dividends — and surplus must go to the charter's purpose: developing football worldwide. Here's how the money flows: each member association signs a four-year development agreement with FIFA — similar to China's Five-Year Plans — specifying projects, KPIs, and budgets. The association submits a proposal; once approved, funds are released in installments, with full monitoring and review — fail the review, and the funding stops. How to apply it: large funds and grant programs can borrow the agreement-plus-installments-plus-review model to avoid handing out money with no oversight.

sentences.cn: 关键理解：非营利 ≠ 不赚钱。限制的是利润分配（无股东分红），剩余资金必须用于章程规定用途——促进全球足球发展
sentences.en: The key insight: nonprofit does not mean not profitable. What's restricted is profit distribution — no shareholder dividends — and surplus must go to the charter's purpose: developing football worldwide.
sentences.note: 表达提示profit distribution → 利润分配；dividend → 分红；surplus → 剩余资金

sentences.cn: 每个会员协会与 FIFA 制定四年发展协议（类似中国十四五），约定项目、KPI、预算。协会提交 proposal 审批后分期拨款，有完整监督和验收机制——验收不通过则停止拨款
sentences.en: Each member association signs a four-year development agreement with FIFA — similar to China's Five-Year Plans — specifying projects, KPIs, and budgets. The association submits a proposal; once approved, funds are released in installments, with full monitoring and review — fail the review, and the funding stops.
sentences.note: 表达提示development agreement → 发展协议；in installments → 分期拨款；review → 验收

sentences.cn: （引用）怎么落地：大额基金/公益拨款可借鉴「协议+分期+验收」机制，避免撒钱无监管
sentences.en: How to apply it: large funds and grant programs can borrow the agreement-plus-installments-plus-review model to avoid handing out money with no oversight.
sentences.note: 表达提示grant program → 公益拨款；oversight → 监管

paraphrase.intent: 想说「非营利不等于不赚钱」
phrases: Nonprofit just means no shareholders to pay.
They can profit — they just can't distribute it.
paraphrase.usage: 第一句通俗，第二句准确

phrases: Money comes in tranches, tied to milestones.
Funding is gated by reviews.
paraphrase.usage: 第一句商务化，第二句更紧凑

scenes.title_cn: 七、权力游戏：行政、立法、司法三权合一
scenes.title_en: The Power Game: Executive, Legislative, and Judicial Power in One Body
scenes.context: FIFA 三权集于一身如何运作；腐败丑闻与治理改革。语域：formal 分析 + 历史事件。
scenes.speak: Finally, the power game. Executive power: expanding the World Cup, setting the calendar — in 2022 Qatar forced the Premier League and La Liga to pause — running the transfer registration system, and allocating development funds. Legislative power: a 50 percent say in global football rules — the handball rule change in 2019, the introduction of VAR, and more. Judicial power: the disciplinary committee hands out punishment — Chelsea was banned from registering players for two windows over minor signings, and Suarez got a nine-match ban for biting. As the episode notes, Montesquieu's separation of powers — inside FIFA, all three powers sit concentrated in a single nonprofit. The cause: in 2015 Swiss police arrested seven FIFA executives; the US Justice Department filed 47 counts involving millions in bribes paid by Qatar to secure the 2022 hosting rights. Some officials took bribes from multiple bidders at once. The fix: since 2016 the hosting rights are decided by a vote of all 211 member associations instead of a handful of top officials — though day-to-day commercial decisions remain opaque.

sentences.cn: 行政权：世界杯扩军、赛程安排（2022 卡塔尔迫使英超西甲停赛）、转会注册系统、发展资金分配
sentences.en: Executive power: expanding the World Cup, setting the calendar — in 2022 Qatar forced the Premier League and La Liga to pause — running the transfer registration system, and allocating development funds.
sentences.note: 表达提示executive power → 行政权；transfer registration → 转会注册；allocate funds → 分配资金

sentences.cn: 立法权：全球足球规则 50% 话语权——手球规则调整（2019）、VAR 技术引入等
sentences.en: Legislative power: a 50 percent say in global football rules — the handball rule change in 2019, the introduction of VAR, and more.
sentences.note: 表达提示handball rule → 手球规则；VAR → 视频助理裁判

sentences.cn: 司法权：纪律委员会处罚——切尔西违规签未成年人禁注册两周期、苏亚雷斯咬人禁赛 9 场
sentences.en: Judicial power: the disciplinary committee hands out punishment — Chelsea was banned from registering players for two windows over minor signings, and Suarez got a nine-match ban for biting.
sentences.note: 表达提示disciplinary committee → 纪律委员会；nine-match ban → 禁赛 9 场

sentences.cn: （引用）孟德斯三权分立，在 FIFA 中三权高度集中于一个非营利组织
sentences.en: Montesquieu's separation of powers — inside FIFA, all three powers sit concentrated in a single nonprofit.
sentences.note: 表达提示separation of powers → 三权分立；concentrated → 高度集中

sentences.cn: 原因：2015 年瑞士警方逮捕 7 名 FIFA 高官，美国司法部 47 项指控涉及卡塔尔为获 2022 主办权贿赂数百万美元。部分官员同时收受多個竞标方贿赂
sentences.en: The cause: in 2015 Swiss police arrested seven FIFA executives; the US Justice Department filed 47 counts involving millions in bribes paid by Qatar to secure the 2022 hosting rights. Some officials took bribes from multiple bidders at once.
sentences.note: 表达提示arrest → 逮捕；bribe → 贿赂；bidder → 竞标方

sentences.cn: 解法：2016 年后世界杯主办权改为 211 个会员投票决定（不再由少数高层拍板），但日常商业决策仍不透明
sentences.en: The fix: since 2016 the hosting rights are decided by a vote of all 211 member associations instead of a handful of top officials — though day-to-day commercial decisions remain opaque.
sentences.note: 表达提示member associations → 会员协会；opaque → 不透明

phrases: They make the rules and judge the cases too.
One body writes, enforces, and judges the law.
paraphrase.chunks: make the rules · judges the cases · writes and enforces
paraphrase.usage: 第一句通俗，第二句点出三权

paraphrase.intent: 想说「改革只改了一部分」
phrases: They fixed the vote, but the backroom deals remain.
Half the reform, half the transparency.
paraphrase.chunks: fixed the vote · backroom deals · half the reform
paraphrase.usage: 第一句直白批评，第二句俏皮总结

practice.cn: 用「price discrimination」说：转播权按市场支付意愿卖不同价。
practice.en: Broadcast rights are sold at different prices based on each market's willingness to pay — classic price discrimination.

practice.cn: 用「category exclusivity」说：有可口可乐在，百事永远进不来。
practice.en: With Coca-Cola signed up, Pepsi will never get category exclusivity.

practice.cn: 用「face value」说：旧规则里转售只能按原价。
practice.en: Under the old rules, resale was capped at face value.

practice.cn: 用「separation of powers」说：FIFA 一家握着行政、立法、司法三权。
practice.en: FIFA holds executive, legislative, and judicial power in one body — no separation of powers.

pitfalls.wrong: The ticket money is 4 times of the last time.
pitfalls.right: Ticket revenue is four times that of the previous edition.
pitfalls.why: times of 是中式搭配；比较结构用 four times that of / four times as much as。

pitfalls.wrong: FIFA is a non-profit organization, so it doesn't make money.
pitfalls.right: Being a nonprofit doesn't mean FIFA doesn't make money — it just can't pay out dividends.
pitfalls.why: 非营利常被误解为不赚钱；正确理解是利润不分红、剩余用于章程用途。

pitfalls.wrong: The broadcast right sells different countries different prices.
pitfalls.right: Broadcast rights are sold at different prices to different markets.
pitfalls.why: 中式语序「卖出不同价格」需用被动语态加介词结构 at different prices to。

pitfalls.wrong: The creator can make money by the video, FIFA no cut.
pitfalls.right: Creators monetize their videos, and FIFA takes no cut.
pitfalls.why: no cut 缺动词且中式拼句；用 takes no cut / takes no commission。

shifts.before: 世界杯是体育赛事，跟商业没关系
shifts.after: 扩军、转播、门票都是生意，商业化越来越激进
非营利限制的是分红，不是赚钱

shifts.before: 足球规则由「足球圈」说了算
shifts.after: FIFA 一家集行政立法司法于一身，治理仍不透明
